name: Stoic Crew
description: An Alloy on the Seametry Hall. One share is a fixed Formula of six tokenized stocks: AAPLx, MSFTx, GOOGLx, AMZNx, METAx and NVDAx, equal in value at the founding quote and never rebalanced. Any wallet can Strike it or Melt it; no one can stop a Melt. On devnet the constituents are stand-ins carrying the real xStocks' token settings.

attributes.value: Equal value at the founding quote
